boot.slowBody.en: This is taking longer than usual. Keep this screen open while your village loads.
boot.slowBody.text: Lokhu kuthatha isikhathi eside kunokujwayelekile. Shiya lesi sikrini sivuliwe ngenkathi isigodi sakho silayisha.

boot.unsupportedBody.en: Update your browser or Android System WebView, then try again. Your saved village stays on this device.
boot.unsupportedBody.text: Buyekeza isiphequluli sakho noma i-Android System WebView, bese uzama futhi. Isigodi sakho esilondoloziwe sihlala kule divayisi.

boot.languageError.en: Your language could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
boot.languageError.text: Ulimi lwakho alukwazanga ukulayishwa. Hlola uxhumano lwakho bese uzama futhi.

common.unknownError.en: The action could not be completed. Please try again.
common.unknownError.text: Lesi senzo asikwazanga ukuqedwa. Sicela uzame futhi.

boot.missing.en: This browser is missing: {detail}. Update your phone (iOS 15 or later) or your browser (Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox from 2021 or later), then open Kagemura again.
boot.missing.text: Lesi siphequluli asinakho: {detail}. Buyekeza ifoni yakho (iOS 15 noma kamuva) noma isiphequluli sakho (Chrome, Safari, Edge noma Firefox kusukela ngo-2021 noma kamuva), bese uvula i-Kagemura futhi.

boot.realSlow.en: Kagemura is taking a long time to load

boot.realSlowBody.en: Nothing has moved for a while. It keeps loading in the background, or you can start again.
boot.realSlowBody.text: Akukho okunyakazile isikhashana. Iyaqhubeka ilayisha ngemuva, noma ungaqala kabusha.

boot.failureBody.en: Check your connection and try again. Your village is saved on this device.
boot.failureBody.text: Hlola uxhumano lwakho bese uzama futhi. Isigodi sakho silondolozwe kule divayisi.

boot.description.en: Kagemura: Ninja Clans. Build a hidden mountain village, train warriors, and raid rival strongholds.
boot.description.text: Kagemura: Ninja Clans. Yakha isigodi esifihlekile ezintabeni, qeqesha amaqhawe, futhi ugasele izinqaba zezimbangi.

boot.pwaDescription.en: Lead a ninja clan: build a hidden mountain village, train warriors, and raid rival strongholds with smoke and sabotage.
boot.pwaDescription.text: Hola isizwe sama-ninja: yakha isigodi esifihlekile ezintabeni, qeqesha amaqhawe, futhi ugasele izinqaba zezimbangi ngentuthu nokonakalisa.
